reviewerRole: Independent semantic and identity review; not author and not final cross-unit acceptance.

reusedReview.reuseBoundary: Exact before-object context only; v5 was reread in full.

mechanicalEvidence.scope: 18 objects, schema/taxonomy/count correspondence, 90 original/reversed option evaluations and message target-ID coverage; this is not semantic acceptance.

summary.unitVerdictReason: The old/current accepted decision is supported and the v3 longest-key cue is resolved, but every question repeats both Reason sentences verbatim across the first two Details fields and eleven questions have one or more wrong-option messages that diagnose another option or defect.

fieldsRead: before whole question from exact N07 manifest
every wrong-option message bound to its actual optionId
method.fictionalScenarioHandling: Scenario contracts were evaluated from facts stated in each prompt/constraints. Sources support general representation-boundary concepts, not invented scenario policies.

technicalChecks.result: The prompt states signer-selected immutable revision R17, stored digest D17, and that the returned digest can be compared with D17; the key to verify and record R17 is supported.
The prompt states numeric UTC offsets are supplied even during repeated local times; parsing the offset yields the effective instant while retaining source text meets both stated needs.

method.styleCue: The old v3 review observed 17/18 uniquely longest keyed options. In this v5 frozen proposal, 0/18 are uniquely longest by whitespace-token count. This is qualitative evidence only; no numeric threshold was applied.
